text:
Predicates:
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
WorkInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
ComputerScience(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
DatabaseCourse(x) ::: x is taking the database course.
ClassWithProfessorDavid(x) ::: x is taking a class with Professor David.
WorkInLab(x) ::: x is working in the lab.
Premises:
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ WorkInLibrary(x)) → ¬ComputerScience(x)) ::: None of the students who currently work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (PartTimeJob(x) → WorkInLibrary(x)) ::: All of the students with part-time jobs offered by the university currently work in the library.
∀x (DatabaseCourse(x) → ComputerScience(x)) ::: All of the students who are taking the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (ClassWithProfessorDavid(x) → DatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All of the students taking a class with Professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (WorkInLab(x) → ClassWithProfessorDavid(x)) ::: All students working in the lab are taking a class with Professor David.
WorkInLab(james) ∧ ¬(WorkInLab(james) ∨ PartTimeJob(james)) ::: James is a student working in the lab. James doesn't work in the lab or have a part-time job offered by the university.
Conclusion:
DatabaseCourse(james) ::: James takes the database course.
